Messages.Author: Damnans
Messages.Body:
1. If two of my Malkavian vampires play 2 Malkavian Rider Clause during the
same referendum, do the 2 next votes I call pass automatically?

2. My predator calls 2 different referenda (political actions), can a
Malkavian vampire play 1 MRC during the first referendum, another Malkavian
play another MRC during the second referendum, and the two next votes I call
pass automatically?

Greetings,
Damnans

Messages.Author: Vendetta
Messages.Body:

Unfortunately, in both cases, according to card text, the next vote that is
cast passes successfully, so both MRCs will trigger at the same time during
the first vote that you call.

Derek

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Correct.
